item.airshipvoyage.gas_supply.amount: Reserve: %s / 200 m³ at ISA standard conditions
item.airshipvoyage.gas_supply.hint: Aim at the blue port under a cell and hold right-click: gas flows while you stay close; Shift+right-click toggles the cell valve
message.airshipvoyage.gas.no_target: Supply stopped: aim at a reachable blue port below a gas cell.
message.airshipvoyage.gas.wrong_gas: The cell contains another gas. Mixing is not supported.
message.airshipvoyage.gas.valve_open: Close the cell's vent valve with Shift + right click.
item.airshipvoyage.ship_part.hint: Right-click a highlighted spot to install (on the slipway or in place of a broken part)
item.airshipvoyage.blueprint.hint1: Right-click the ground to place the project (bow points where you look)
item.airshipvoyage.blueprint.hint2: Sneak + right-click near a site: progress; when complete, launch from the slipway
message.airshipvoyage.blueprint.title: Blueprint: %s
message.airshipvoyage.blueprint.howto: Hold the blueprint: an outline shows the spot. Rings need flat solid support and the volume must be clear.
message.airshipvoyage.site.out_of_world: The project does not fit within the world height
message.airshipvoyage.site.overlaps: Another airship or construction site is here
message.airshipvoyage.site.no_support: No support under the rings: %s of %s spots (e.g. block %s %s %s). Level the site
message.airshipvoyage.site.obstructed: The building volume is blocked: block %s %s %s
message.airshipvoyage.site.placed: Project placed. Install parts in the highlighted spots, rings first
message.airshipvoyage.build.completed: Installed: %s. The airship is complete: sneak + right-click with the blueprint to launch
message.airshipvoyage.build.view_blocked: Cannot reach the %s spot: a block is in the way
message.airshipvoyage.build.occupied_ent: %s: someone is standing in the way
message.airshipvoyage.build.launched: Launched from the slipway. Check the gas cells; use a cylinder bank on the blue ports to fill them.
commands.airshipvoyage.no_site: No airship under construction within 128 blocks
commands.airshipvoyage.under_constructio: This airship is still under construction: complete and launch it first
commands.airshipvoyage.no_cells: This airship has no gas cells
commands.airshipvoyage.weighoff: Weighed off: cells filled to %s%% — neutral at this altitude
commands.airshipvoyage.weighoff_heavy: Too heavy: needs %s%% fill, cells filled completely
commands.airshipvoyage.not_complete: The airship is not complete yet (/airship info shows what is left; /airship build complete finishes it)
commands.airshipvoyage.build_completed: All parts installed — ready to launch: /airship build launch
commands.airshipvoyage.unknown_stage: Unknown telegraph stage: full_astern, half_astern, slow_astern, stop, slow, half, full
message.airshipvoyage.helm.taken: At the helm. W/S telegraph by steps, X stop, A/D turn, Space/Ctrl nose up/down, ↑/↓ and G trim, B ballast, V gas, Shift to leave
message.airshipvoyage.helm.no_helm: This airship has no helm station
message.airshipvoyage.helm.occupied: Another player is at the helm
message.airshipvoyage.helm.under_constru: The airship is still on the slipway
hud.airshipvoyage.title: HELM
hud.airshipvoyage.keys: W/S telegraph · X stop · A/D turn · Space/Ctrl nose up/down
hud.airshipvoyage.rising: ▲ Lighter than air by %s kg — will rise to about %s m, then excess gas vents
hud.airshipvoyage.sinking: ▼ Heavier than air by %s kg — sinking: B drops ballast, keep V closed
hud.airshipvoyage.keys2: ↑/↓ trim ballast · G auto trim · P autopilot · B drop ballast · V vent gas · Shift leave
commands.airshipvoyage.gas_summary: Gas (fwd / aft): %s · lift %s kg, mass %s kg. %s
hud.airshipvoyage.rising_short: ▲ Lighter by %s kg — rises to ≈ %s m
item.airshipvoyage.repair_kit.hint: Right-click a damaged part or gas cell to repair it (+20); patches cells too
message.airshipvoyage.repair.nothing: %s: nothing to repair (or the cell is burning)
message.airshipvoyage.fire.no_hydrogen: %s: won't burn — only hydrogen cells can be ignited
item.airshipvoyage.fire_extinguisher.hin: Hold right-click to spray foam (6 m, 12 s of charge): puts out fire, burning mobs and burning gas cells
item.airshipvoyage.fuel_canister.hint: Right-click an engine gondola to fill its tank; any other part fills the emptiest tank
message.airshipvoyage.fuel.empty_can: The can is empty — refill it (can + coal block)
message.airshipvoyage.mooring.no_ship: Bring the bow within %s m of the mast
message.airshipvoyage.mooring.attached: Line made fast (%s m), the winch hauls it in to %s m
hud.airshipvoyage.ap_on: AUTOPILOT: heading %s°, altitude %s m (A/D, Space/Ctrl set; P off)
item.airshipvoyage.weathervane.hint: Instrument: fits on the bow ring, shows the wind at the helm
hud.airshipvoyage.wind_no_instrument: Wind: no instrument — fit a weathervane
